heading_en: Revocation of Approval of the Internal Model Approach
summary_ja: 要件を満たさない事由が生じた場合に、内部モデル方式の承認を取り消し得ることを定める。
summary_en: Allows the Commissioner to revoke the approval of the internal model approach where it is found inappropriate to calculate the market risk equivalent amount using it.
paragraphs: Where the case listed in paragraph (1), item (iii) of the preceding Article applies and the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency determines that it is inappropriate to calculate the market risk equivalent amount using the internal model approach, the Commissioner may revoke the approval under Article 250.
